entry_points.text: MSR protocol serves info, CPUID, reset-hold, hypervisor features, preferred and registered GPA, page-state and termination with architected responses; unknown or failed identifier preserves input.

Memory exits for IO, debug, time, CPUID, cache and call re-dispatch via shared dispatcher after validation. NPF sanitizes error bits, may fast-probe or call fault service with RMP repair. Interrupt counts, MSR routes by direction, window requests events, clears VIRQ and counts.
vCPU create always inits SNP VMSA mutex; without ES succeeds; else reserves SNP-safe VMSA page, marks pending and guest addrs invalid and caches secure-TSC flag.

exports.text: Top-level secure-guest exit handler. Accepts a vCPU context and reports prompt guest resume, exit to userspace, or host error.
Shared SVM exit dispatcher. Validates numeric reason, hardens index, invokes registered handler or unexpected path.
Host bus read and write dispatch. Signals absent table as memory failure, normalizes first acceptance to success, preserves device errors.
SNP maintenance helpers. Reload refreshes loaded save area under mutex; RMP fault has full repair form and empty inline form when disabled.
Emulation and request helpers. AP reset-hold skip and hold, encrypted MMIO sync or queue, and make-request-and-kick with wait propagation.

hazards.text: Guest page-state descriptor is read once for bounds and traversal due to TOCTOU. Secure MMIO rejects null and host-stack data pointers. Firmware failures go to guest; transport failures without firmware status become host errors.
2M-aligned save areas rejected and control pages kept unaligned to avoid spurious RMP faults from huge-page collisions and erratum-driven fault mis-signalling.
Exit prep treats over-8B as fatal, wrapper clamps and warns without pending state. Synthetic-colliding error bits warn once and clear; reads trace satisfied versus leftover.

Fetch-in-guest-mode corrected by CPL when enabled; empty decode under protections distinguished from fetch or fault before inject, triple-fault or retry. Unexpected RMP states warn rate-limited without modification. Dumps disabled by default and need decrypted save area else skip regs.

SNP debug decrypt returns page to hypervisor; return failure leaks page even on success. Firmware failures log codes and free scratch. Shared convert tolerates split failures. Partial PIO after device loss is not redirected.

invariants.text: Dispatch checks MSR-protocol bits first; zero or unmapped control address resumes benignly. SNP needs registered address, usage zero and required inputs; SNP-only types fail non-SNP with dedicated guest errors.

PSC start needs userspace opt-in, derives entry bound from scratch length and header-errors on bad end index. AP create checks identity, features and address, rejects 2M-aligned save area and unknown selectors.

Guest requests need SNP, page-aligned distinct addresses and valid report registers; malformed gets invalid-input resume. Extended report consults certs flag to exit with addr and len or clear terminator and call firmware; certs statuses map to re-enter, length, busy, generic or host error.

MMIO moves at most 8 bytes per piece; kernel APIC tried before generic bus. Absent table versus no range versus no acceptor are distinct, the latter two surfacing as not-supported and stopping progress. Lookup retreats to first overlap then scans in index order to first acceptance.
vCPU page map is a thin forward with fixed final argument. Privilege level reads directly from save area.
SNP-safe alloc returns zeroed single page with non-2M frame on SNP hosts via split pair keeping unaligned member; elsewhere it equals normal zeroed allocation.

Decrypted VMSA is ES-only; inactive protection yields live image without firmware. Debug allowed by policy with SNP zeroed-FW versus legacy normal-page paths; release is no-op when inactive or absent, else frees one page. Disabled builds always report absence and no-op release.

Unexpected reasons exit as internal error with dedicated suberror and two payload words for reason and last-entry CPU. Halt counts exit, advances past instruction and enters halted state; AP hold variant enters reset-hold instead.

Encrypted string PIO rejects huge or overflowing lengths, completes zero byte, else stages pointer and count and chunks by page capacity. Each chunk goes to kernel PIO; remainder advances by count times size. Kernel PIO needs all elements; first-element miss prepares userspace exit, later disappearance drops or zero-fills remainder.

ES MSR policy leaves GHCB EFER PAT uninterrupted; TSC_AUX follows RDTSCP RDPID caps, TSC-freq read suppressed only under secure TSC, XSS follows usable-exposed XSAVES. Disable is set-false. CPUID leaf 8000001F EBX relaxes GPA mask. Entry preserves XCR PKRU SSS, debug masks when swappable, and virtualized TSC_AUX.

Range is shared only if every RMP lookup succeeds unassigned; 2M possible only for large folio fully inside shared 2M window. Make-private is SNP-only single-page, already-assigned ok, else 2M or 4K record. Make-shared walks frames, splits touched large entries, converts with matching flush and yields. Invalidate is SNP-only and kicks vCPUs whose valid guest VMSA falls inside.
Emulation without confidentiality is unrestricted; hidden register state retries, already-decoded completes, otherwise non-empty prefetch required with fault, triple-fault or retry fallbacks.

locks.text: Per-vCPU SNP save-area mutex serializes loaded-area reload against AP create and destroy updates to pending address and waiting state.
Per-VM guest-request mutex serializes shared request and response staging across concurrent vCPUs.

Bus lookup uses SRCU dereference with barrier after read lock for step visibility. Control-block dumps hold scoped mutex. Range invalidate needs address-space write lock; racy VMSA reads may false-positive but never false-negative.

state_machines.text: Tri-state result: zero leaves to userspace with completion armed, one resumes guest, negative is host error; success and error also mirrored to guest-visible control.

Valid create stores pending save addr, destroy stores invalid marker; both set waiting-for-reset and, except deferred create, request protected-state update and kick. First SIPI records arrival; later wakes complete hold via event status or GHCB fields.
RMP repair validates private, slot, backing and table, small mapping completes, else splits large entry tolerating races, invalidates range, traces and releases reference.

structs.text: Per-vCPU secure state keeps scratch, mapped and registered addrs, PSC indices, pending and loaded save addrs and hold and wait flags. Userspace areas carry hypercall, certs, system-event and one MMIO fragment; bus key is addr and len; emulated exit carries len, dir, reason, GPA and data.

Observed control state has exit code and info words, inject and interrupt controls plus segments, control and debug regs, IP and flags, stack, CPL and XSAVE. Encrypted dumps use image features, CET and regs; legacy splits stack and acc in save area and rest in vCPU cache.

ABI map KVM_HC_MAP_GPA_RANGE with KVM_MAP_GPA_RANGE_DECRYPTED ENCRYPTED PAGE_SZ_4K PAGE_SZ_2M; SNP SVM_VMGEXIT_PSC EXT_GUEST_REQUEST GUEST_REQUEST AP_CREATION; guest GHCB_ERR_INVALID_INPUT INVALID_EVENT MISSING_INPUT NOT_REGISTERED; certs SNP_GUEST_VMM_ERR_INVALID_LEN BUSY GENERIC.

ABI exits KVM_EXIT_INTERNAL_ERROR UNEXPECTED_REASON two-word payload, SYSTEM_EVENT SEV_TERM, SNP_REQ_CERTS, AP_RESET_HOLD, HLT, IO IN OUT PIO_PAGE_OFFSET, MMIO; MP RUNNABLE AP_RESET_HOLD HALTED; REQ EVENT UPDATE_PROTECTED_GUEST_STATE; buses PIO MMIO fast-probe; MSR GHCB_MSR_TERM PSC REG_GPA PREF_GPA HV_FT AP_RESET_HOLD CPUID SEV_INFO with responses.
